# Vendored browser libraries

These pinned files are served locally. No CDN or frontend build is required.

- `htmx.min.js`: htmx 2.0.11, from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/htmx.min.js`
- `sse.js`: htmx SSE extension 2.2.4, from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx-ext-sse@2.2.4/dist/sse.js`

Their upstream licenses are included alongside the scripts. Update the version,
script, and license together, then run the browser smoke checks.
